# Build tools of raisin_master on Ubuntu: what ./raisin (the launcher, raisin build, test and
# cppcheck) runs, and the formatter developers edit with. apt package names separated by spaces or newlines (one per line by convention),
# '#' starts a comment; version-specific packages go in apt.build.ubuntu-<version>.txt.
# install_system_deps.sh (run by ./raisin --install) installs the ones that are missing, and the
# raisin-base build image installs this list, so its containers need nothing more.

# The launcher creates the raisin virtual environment, and src/setup.sh (raisin-manifest)
# a temporary one to install vcs into
python3
python3-venv
python3-virtualenv
python3-pip
# raisin build
cmake
ninja-build
# raisin build configures with the vcpkg toolchain, which bootstraps vcpkg; its
# scripts/bootstrap.sh requires these four
curl
zip
unzip
tar
# raisin setup and the git commands read Git LFS files
git-lfs
# GitHub CLI: developers log in to GitHub and read the private repositories' token with it, and
# src/setup.sh (raisin-manifest) may call it. 22.04's gh (2.4.0) has no `gh auth token`
gh
# raisin cppcheck
cppcheck
# raisin test --coverage
gcovr
# Editors format C++ with it on save. The pre-commit hook does not use it: it fetches its own
# pinned clang-format, so this one can differ in version (22.04 has 14, 24.04 has 18)
clang-format
